description: Bifolium of potential state accounts in Judaeo-Arabic on large pages (~12cm) listing immense sums of money. Dating: 18th- or 19th-century based on the paleography and kuruş currency. A variety of names are mentioned that may help narrow this dating estimate through further research: Dāwūd Fuerte, Muḥammad Sharqawī, Khiḍr Qaṭawī, Mūsa ʿAkūbaṣ, among many others.
description_he: דפדפת של חשבונות מאוחרים נקיים מאוד ביהודית-ערבית על דפים גדולים (~12 ס'מ).
